newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-FTSE puts bought, positions rolled forward.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-FTSE puts bought, positions rolled forward.

text.p: UK equity traded options business was extremely light on Thursday, with the main activity centred on FTSE 100 index options, dealers said.
The biggest deal by early afternoon was to buy 1,000 September 4500 puts in FTSE at 10p which will make money if FTSE futures make a sharp drop.
Other activity related to rolling forward positions into the September expiry month from August -- which expires on Friday.
At 1205 GMT, the cash index was up 6.0 at 5009.6 while September futures slipped back two points 5,018.
